command_templates.name: parse_amcache_hve
command_templates.when: When parsing an Amcache.hve file and outputting to CSV.

usage_description: AmcacheParser is used to parse the Amcache.hve registry hive, which can provide insights into installed programs and their associated SHA1 hashes.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Unassociated entries with no program entry.
SHA1 hash does not match known good values.

known_false_positives: Legitimate system updates or installations may result in unassociated entries.
Some legitimate applications may have SHA1 hashes that are not widely recognized.
